mentions.name: Beamy
mentions.description: This app syncs audiobooks for the Apple Books app, filling the gap left by Apple's lack of built-in audiobook syncing. It is still in development and expected to go live in the coming days.
mentions.problem: Apple doesn't sync audiobooks on the Books app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was annoyed that Apple doesn't sync audiobooks on the Books app, so I built https://getbeamy.app/
